items.title: 'Exploiting and deceiving' teens to commit crimes using apps is on the rise
items.description: Criminal syndicates are targeting vulnerable children with no criminal history, low IQ and intellectual disabilities to carry out their dirty work through encrypted apps.

items.title: New Apple child safety features 'part inspired' by Australia social media ban
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says Apple chief executive Tim Cook called him personally to tell him the changes were "inspired by Australia's world-leading social media age ban".

items.title: 'Slap in the face': Mother's scathing assessment of NDIS bill
items.description: Exhausted families could be plunged further into crisis and have greater interaction with child protection services under the proposed overhaul of the NDIS, advocates say.

items.title: Barbeques Galore to shut, hundreds of workers facing redundancy
items.description: It will shut its 62 company-owned stores in the coming weeks and working through "transitional arrangements" with 27 stores owned by franchises, with hundreds of staff facing redundancy.

items.title: Woman hails 'hero' husband who shot alleged home invader
items.description: Stabbing victim Di Blessing praises her husband's bravery during an alleged home invasion in northern New South Wales.

items.title: Palestinians trapped between Israeli forces and Hamas rule, report finds
items.description: A UN report finds that Palestinians are being subjected to "mass atrocities" by Israeli forces and being "violently repressed and controlled by the very faction that claims to govern them".

items.title: How the regime is sneaking tankers past Trump's blockade
items.description: Amid new strikes, the future of the Strait of Hormuz has again been plunged into uncertainty, but ships are finding a way through.

items.title: Iran says ticket allocation for World Cup withdrawn days before tournament
items.description: Iran's football federation (FFIRI) has now begun selling tickets for the national team's matches against New Zealand, Belgium, and Egypt through its official website, Fars news agency reported.

items.title: The Big Issue celebrates three decades in Australia with special edition
items.description: The magazine has become a lifeline for its vendors and is marking its 30th year with a special edition, pouring more proceeds in the pockets of those who need it most.

items.title: Year 12 students in Melbourne caught cheating using AI
items.description: An all-boys school in Melbourne's outer east has taken action after several students were caught cheating on a Year 12 exam using AI.

items.title: Outpouring of support as ex-NRL player Kane Evans comes out
items.description: Evans is the second professional rugby league player in Australian history to publicly come out, following Ian Roberts in 1995.

items.title: Escaped devil spotted on suburban Gold Coast CCTV after week on loose
items.description: A two-year-old Tasmanian devil has been on the loose since last Tuesday when she leapt out of her enclosure at a Gold Coast wildlife park.

items.title: Aussie star calls out $130k prize money disparity at tennis tournament
items.description: Priscilla Hon draws attention to the difference between the men's and women's winners' prize money at the Libéma Open in The Netherlands.

items.title: Live: Matildas re-take the lead in frenetic Mexico rematch
items.description: The Matildas will be hoping for a degree of redemption as they look to put Saturday night's disjointed performance in Newcastle to bed in their second international against Mexico. Follow live.

items.title: Idris Elba thinks audiences won't support a black James Bond
items.description: Idris Elba has quashed rumours he was ever in the running to play James Bond, saying audiences are unlikely to come along for the ride if Bond is played by a black actor.

items.title: The criticism Marc Fennell always gets for Stuff the British Stole
items.description: Two years in the making, the Walkley Award-winning journalist is back with the third season of his globe-trotting historical mystery series. He's treating it like it's the last.

items.title: From the Kimberley to Sweden, how heartbreak helped me take a travel leap
items.description: As I approached the age of 30, I longed to travel outside of Australia, but there was always an excuse or obstacle. A chance to share my culture with the world finally got me there.

items.title: Donald Trump booed at NBA Finals as chaos ensues outside
items.description: US President Donald Trump cops the vitriol of the Madison Square Garden crowd after causing chaos to attend the NBA Finals.

items.title: Mongols fugitive taken down by dog squad after fleeing traffic stop on foot
items.description: Police have arrested fugitive Top End Mongols bikie Brandt Graham five days after the 44-year-old escaped from custody last week, sparking an "extensive manhunt".

items.title: Police say 17yo fired 30 shots at wrong funeral venue for Sydney crime boss
items.description: Two people are charged over a shooting at what was advertised as the venue for a Sydney crime boss's funeral.

items.title: Young couple told by agent that landlords would not rent to 'people like you'
items.description: Hopeful renters say negative stereotypes about young people are making it almost impossible to secure a rental on the Sunshine Coast.

items.title: Notre Dame university halts new nursing student enrolments for another year
items.description: The university says it will not take new students for its nursing program for another year, as it needs to "rebalance enrolments across the program within accredited program capacity".

items.title: Family's 'worst nightmare' after purchasing home filled with defects
items.description: After a young family invests their life savings in their dream home, only to discover it is filled with defects, SA's consumer watchdog issues a public warning notice about the builder responsible and seven other traders.

items.title: ABC boss confirms ex-news director in the dark about replacement hunt
items.description: Managing director Hugh Marks is questioned by Sally Sara over Justin Stevens's sudden resignation last month, in addition to controversies over the hiring of Grace Tame and subsequent comments by radio host Charlie Pickering.

items.title: Redevelopment of Brisbane milk factory site proposed ahead of Olympics
items.description: Developer Mark Stockwell has revealed plans for an apartment tower, hotel and Olympic hub at the Parmalat milk processing site on Brisbane's central riverfront.
